verdict.rationale: Blaxel is an agent-hosting platform, so consuming MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. However, all MCP evidence in the pack is server-side: Blaxel hosts remote MCP servers, exposes each sandbox via a built-in MCP server, and publishes an official MCP server. None of it shows Blaxel or its hosted agents connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools. Hosting MCP servers is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this client-side story.
